summary: Email research for Blueprint MVP (architectural design/blueprint management platform). Found 7 emails across 2 target organizations: Ashtabula County Building Department and City of Ashtabula Planning & Community Development.

targets.fit_rationale: Primary building authority for Ashtabula County. Digital blueprint submission and review tools would streamline permit processing for all non-residential projects, which are now digital-only.

contacts.name: Cari Ellsworth
contacts.title: Office Manager, Permit Technician
contacts.notes: Primary contact for permit applications. Office manager handling day-to-day operations.

contacts.name: Taylor Todd
contacts.title: Administrative Assistant - Commercial Projects
contacts.notes: Handles commercial project applications. Key contact for non-residential digital submissions.

contacts.name: Tiffany French
contacts.title: Administrative Assistant
contacts.notes: Secondary administrative contact for project inquiries.

targets.organization: City of Ashtabula Planning & Community Development
targets.fit_rationale: Issues zoning permits and coordinates with County Building Department. Digital blueprint integration between city and county would improve workflow for all Ashtabula city construction projects.

contacts.name: Mary Church
contacts.title: Assistant Director
contacts.notes: Assistant Director of Planning & Community Development. Best initial contact for partnership discussions.

contacts.name: Amy Coursen
contacts.title: Project Administrator
contacts.notes: Project Administrator - manages specific development projects and could benefit from blueprint collaboration tools.

contacts.name: Kimberly Adams
contacts.title: Administrative Assistant
contacts.notes: Administrative support - handles permit processing and general inquiries.

contacts.name: William Jepson
contacts.title: Engineering Technician
contacts.notes: Engineering Tech - reviews technical aspects of projects and would use blueprint tools.

key_insights: Ashtabula County Building Department has transitioned to digital-only submissions for non-residential projects, making them an ideal candidate for enhanced blueprint management tools.

City of Ashtabula recently consolidated Engineering, Housing, Zoning, and Code Enforcement into a single Planning & Community Development department, indicating appetite for operational efficiency improvements.
Both organizations currently handle digital submissions via email (PDF attachments), lacking version control, annotation tools, or collaborative review features.

County Building Department serves as the primary building authority for the entire county including the City of Ashtabula - coordinated outreach to both could demonstrate integrated city-county workflow benefits.

outreach_strategy.primary_target: Mary Church (City of Ashtabula) AND Cari Ellsworth (County Building Dept)
outreach_strategy.recommended_approach: Position Blueprint MVP as a pilot program to streamline the city-county permit coordination. Emphasize the County's existing digital transition and the City's recent department consolidation as proof points for technology adoption.
outreach_strategy.value_proposition: Reduce permit review cycles, eliminate version confusion with multiple PDF exchanges, enable mobile field access for inspectors, and create audit trail of approvals/markups.

research_notes: Emails found via official government websites. Ashtabula County Building Department staff emails follow pattern: [FirstInitial][LastName]@ashtabulacounty.us (or .gov for some). City of Ashtabula uses [firstinitial][lastName]@cityofashtabula.com pattern for individual emails, with department emails (PCD@) for general inquiries.
